[Pedagogy review · Suggestion · extension · pf-a058bbc491]
Append to p7-q12: (d) Find the interior angle sums of regular polygons with 20 and 40 sides. Answers: 3240° and 6840°. (e) Find each interior angle of these polygons. Answers: 162° and 171°. (f) How far below 180° is each angle? Answers: 18° and 9°. (g) When the number of sides doubles from 20 to 40, does the interior angle sum double? Answer: No; 6840° is 360° greater than twice 3240°.
